name: oak
$comment: FFmpeg (+ pkgconf, librsvg on Windows) for every desktop platform CI/CD builds — Linux, macOS and Windows — with the project's feature set (every free codec + hwaccel, mirroring tooling/ffmpeg/build-ffmpeg.sh's configure switches). Local builds may keep using tooling/install-deps.sh + tooling/ffmpeg/build-ffmpeg.sh. ffmpeg is pinned to 9.0.1#1 via overrides; builtin-baseline pins the rest of the port tree.
